input: Create a grocery list template I can reuse weekly

gold.taskTitle: Build a Reusable Weekly Grocery List Template
gold.taskDescription: Create a structured, reusable grocery list template the user can rely on every week for their shopping needs.

questions.title: What format do you want the template in?
questions.description: For example: a printed paper sheet, a spreadsheet, a notes app, or a dedicated grocery app.

questions.title: How many people are you shopping for each week?
questions.description: Knowing the household size helps determine quantities and category scale.

questions.title: Which store or stores do you shop at regularly?
questions.description: The template can be ordered by store layout or split by store if multiple are used.

questions.title: What main food categories matter most to your household?
questions.description: For example: produce, dairy, meat, snacks, beverages, frozen, bakery, or pantry staples.

questions.title: Do you follow any dietary rules or restrictions?
questions.description: For example: vegetarian, gluten-free, halal, kosher, or any allergies to account for.

questions.title: Should the template include a column for quantities or budget?
questions.description: Determines whether the template tracks amounts, estimated costs, or both alongside item names.

questions.title: Do you meal-plan before shopping or shop from habit?
questions.description: This shapes whether the template should link to weekly meals or simply list standing staple items.
